source.publisher: Inventaire du patrimoine architectural, Région de Bruxelles-Capitale
source.title: Gare du Midi et bâtiments annexes
facts_used: The three Fonsny administrative/postal buildings use aluminium frames with a fixed lower part, top-hung transom and sunshade.
No. 47 is symmetrically organized in three bodies; the axial body has seven levels and the end bodies six.
No. 47 windows and spandrels are set in a concrete grid with projecting-brick spandrels.
In the axial body of no. 47, lateral bays run through the full height of the upper storeys with a beveled reveal and a bowed glass-block wall.

production_mapping.scope: existing authored FonsnyWingSouth, FonsnyCentral and FonsnyWingNorth presentation only
production_mapping.mapping_claim: The existing three-block Fonsny hero is a visualization convention for the documented administrative/postal frontage; this contract does not assert survey-address registration of each authored block.
production_mapping.central_body_convention: FonsnyCentral already carries seven authored upper levels and the legacy VerticalGlassTower presentation; replacing that legacy single tower with two lateral full-height glass-block bays is a source-bounded visualization convention, not a cadastral or survey placement claim.
